results.title: Comelec reminds public: No fees for voter certifications
results.content: MANILA, Philippines – The Commission on Elections (Comelec) on Thursday reminded the public that voter certifications are issued free of charge nationwide amid reports of social media posts falsely claiming that applicants were being charged for the document.
